Introducing Saved Views, available today on every paid plan. If you find yourself rebuilding the same filters and sort orders every time you check your board, this one's for you. Saved Views let you capture a specific combination of filters, grouping, and sorting, then return to it in a single click instead of setting it up from scratch each time.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so whether you're tracking overdue tasks, watching a sprint backlog, or keeping an eye on a specific teammate's workload, you can keep every view ready to go. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to hand a teammate the exact perspective they need without walking them through setup steps.

Saved Views works across every list in your workspace and syncs automatically as your data changes, so shared views always stay current for everyone who uses them.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
